basic_info.description: Perched above San Francisco in Diamond Heights, this spacious, house-like townhome offers incredible city views and a smart, versatile layout. A wall of windows in the living area frames stunning downtown vistas, while the formal dining room flows into a sunny kitchen with a breakfast nook that opens to a private patio and garden - a rare city retreat. A powder room completes this level. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts mesmerizing views, abundant closet space, and an en-suite bath. Two generous additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a sunroom offer flexibility for work or relaxation. The ground floor features a formal entry, a massive 2+ car garage, and a bonus room that's perfect for a home gym, office, or extra storage. Ideally located near Noe Valley, Twin Peaks, and Forest Hill, enjoy stunning vistas, green spaces, easy access to transit, and a wide variety of shops and restaurants. This is a rare opportunity to own a view-filled retreat in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
